##### *Episode 13: Behind the tech. Behind the change. Meet the humans of CXAI. Our behind-the-scenes series spotlighting the passionate people driving innovation at CXAI.*


# Meet Yash


Meet Yash Kumar, our Tech Lead for AI & Software at CXAI. Yash leads engineering on BTS (Behind-the-Scenes) - the core AI engine powering automation, content management, and workflows across the CXAI platform. A self-described "hacker" and 10X hackathon winner, Yash shares what it takes to build intelligent systems that don't just execute, but adapt, decide, and orchestrate the future of work.


#### In this episode, you’ll learn:


-


⁠The one shift in software that made him fall for AI


-


His favorite CXAI feature (and why he uses it every single day


-


The toughest problem he's solved at CXAI so far


-


What he's building next and why it's a big deal for hybrid teams


-


The biggest myth about AI


-


And what a "hacker" does when he steps away from the keyboard
